integrity.claim_scope: The proof gives the exact \(q=2\) quotient polynomial, the full singular-parameter test, and the complete factorization of the exceptional member.
integrity.literature_boundary: The lead source prints \(\lambda\in K\) in Theorem 4.5; its separate point-stabilizer Theorem 4.9 has a \(\lambda\ne1\) exclusion but does not state or imply the line-stabilizer \(q=2\) factorization.
integrity.reproducibility: All critical identities are exact in characteristic \(2\) and are replayed by `verification/verify.py`; the infinite-field smoothness conclusion is proved symbolically rather than inferred from finite sampling.

scientific_limitations: The claim concerns only the \(q=2\) specialization of the line-stabilizer \(\operatorname{AGL}(2,q)\) pencil in Theorem 4.5.
It does not re-prove the source's separate minimum-degree theorem or classify full automorphism groups.
An informal or poorly indexed correction to the published theorem could exist even though no such correction was located in the checked literature.
title: The missing \(q=2\) exception in the minimal \(\operatorname{AGL}(2,q)\)-invariant quartic pencil
